scripts.dev: pnpm prisma:generate && wrangler dev --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var DEPLOYED_AT:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)
scripts.dev:preview: pnpm prisma:generate && wrangler dev --env preview --port 8787 --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var DEPLOYED_AT:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)
scripts.deploy: pnpm prisma:generate && wrangler deploy --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var DEPLOYED_AT:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)
scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm prisma:generate && wrangler deploy --env staging --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var DEPLOYED_AT:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm prisma:generate && wrangler deploy --env production --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var DEPLOYED_AT:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)
scripts.db:airtable-migrate: echo '[DEPRECATED] Prefer POST /api/promote — see docs/REVIEW_APP_PROMOTE_API.md' && dotenv -e .dev.vars -- tsx scripts/airtable-to-supabase-bulk-migrate.ts
